summary.whatChanges: Adds an `allowBuilds` section to the pnpm workspace config that disables esbuild's postinstall build script, so pnpm will not run esbuild's native binary install step during dependency installation.
behaviorChanges: During `pnpm install`, esbuild's postinstall/build script is no longer executed
pnpm no longer prompts/warns about esbuild as an ignored or unapproved build script
risks: If esbuild relies on its postinstall step to fetch/link the platform-specific binary, builds or dev servers using esbuild could fail at runtime
`allowBuilds` requires a pnpm version that supports the key; older pnpm may ignore or reject the config
